name: hevo-data
description: Connects your AI agent to Hevo. Includes the hevo-pipelines skill and the Hevo MCP server, which manages your Pipelines, Destinations, Models, Workflows, team users, and OAuth accounts through the Hevo API.

interface.shortDescription: View and manage your Hevo Pipelines
interface.longDescription: Lets your agent view and manage your Pipelines, Destinations, Models, Workflows, team users, and OAuth accounts in Hevo, with your own API credentials. The agent is read-only until you allow changes.
defaultPrompt: List my Hevo Pipelines and display the ones that need attention.
